title: Formulary Policy: Preferred Meters on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program
content:
**Policy.** On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, strips are covered only for the meter written on the program, and a meter is covered only when its model is on the tier's preferred meter list. Both facts are read from the program record and the tier's list.

**Tiers that require a formulary exception.** On tiers where a non-preferred meter needs a payer formulary exception, a meter that is not on the list, and strips for it, are covered only after the payer approves a formulary exception, recorded as an authorization grant for E0607 with the basis payer prior authorization. Until then the customer may switch to a preferred meter on a new written order, or receive the non-preferred meter and its strips under the advance liability notice rules.

**Tiers without that requirement.** On tiers where a non-preferred meter does not need a formulary exception, every listed model is covered.

**Changing meters.** A change of meter is written as a program change only from a new written order naming the new meter, and strips for the old meter are not shipped after the change.

| Meter on the program | Tier needs an exception | Exception grant on file | Meter and its strips covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| on the tier's list | either | — | Yes |
| not on the list | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| not on the list | Yes | No | No — the customer may switch on a new written order, or receive it under the liability notice rules |
